description.zh: 产品类型，目前仅支持**ANT_CLOUD_AUTH**（金融级实人），其他均退市。
description.en: The product type. Currently, only **ANT_CLOUD_AUTH** (financial-grade ID Verification) is supported. All other types have been discontinued.

descriptions.zh:
- 服务地址：cloudauth.aliyuncs.com
- 请求方法：HTTPS POST和GET。
- 安全规则：保障系统安全性监控规则，例如接口被刷、账号异常盗用等，触发阈值，系统支持进行告警。
descriptions.en:
- Service endpoint: cloudauth.aliyuncs.com
- Request method: HTTPS POST and GET.
- Security rules: monitoring rules that ensure system security, such as API abuse and abnormal account theft. When a threshold is triggered, the system sends an alert.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth query-customize-flow-strategy --user-id 126005125163 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --product-type ANT_CLOUD_AUTH --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
